_instructions: Resource limits for every workspace command and terminal (shell, python, terminal_open and the previews they serve), read live by the tool worker when each one starts. Each limit counts the command's whole process tree together, not each process alone. memory_mb: private memory of all its processes together. processes: processes and threads running at once. cpu_seconds: CPU time of all its processes together, ended ones included. A command past a limit is stopped and its output says which. Sandbox ability commands use their own limits (abilities/Core/sandbox/limits.json), counted the same way.
